Every render has `page_title`, `current_path`, `param_<name>` for each URL query value (`?city=Austin` is `param_city`; the first value) and `aggregate.<name>` (app.yaml aggregates once computed; app-wide, not per viewer). `current_user` is a signed-in test, not a value to print: `{{#current_user}}…{{/current_user}}` (`{{if .current_user}}` in gotmpl) shows for a signed-in viewer and `{{^current_user}}…{{/current_user}}` for an anonymous one, while `{{current_user}}` writes nothing (`true` inside a script or through `| json`). Read the viewer through `user_id`, `user_email`, `user_role` or `user.<column>`.

A signed-in viewer adds `user` (every `_benmore_users` column: `{{user.email}}`, `.user.email` in gotmpl), `user_id`, `user_email`, `user_role`, `user_roles` (comma-separated), `logged_in`, `notification_count`, and `user_group_id` / `user_app_role` when they have a tenant / tenant role. An anonymous viewer has none of these; a template reads them as empty.
